title: metadata-protocol: duplicatePackage leaves two names out of step with the renamed objects: a field named after a prefixed object keeps its key under a renamed `name`, and a bare object's view item keeps its `OBJECT.VIEWKEY` name
body:
Filing gate ①, finding classes (a) and (b), one family card for two defects. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `huangyiirene` · session `session_01YRp5z4kK6vgYkrdH97ztsy`, from #23527's dev report (PR #23536, out-of-scope findings 1 and 3). They are carried on one card under the filing gate's per-fire quota. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

`reach:` the named producer `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.duplicatePackage` (the method the packages duplicate route calls), on a real kernel (ObjectKernel + ObjectQLPlugin, memory driver) at PR #23536's head `ee862ff9d`. The HTTP door was not driven.

**Reader who acts:** triage, to grade and route. Both fixes land in `duplicatePackage` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`), in the same region as PR #23536 (#23527), so they land after it. The two items can go as one PR or two.

## 1. A field named after a prefixed object gets a renamed `name` under its old key (class a)

**Measured.** The source object `dupsrc_customer` has fields keyed `dupsrc_customer` and `x_dupsrc_customer`. The copy `dupdst_customer` keeps both KEYS, but their `name` values change:
- `dupsrc_customer` gets `name: 'dupdst_customer'`;
- `x_dupsrc_customer` gets `name: 'x_dupdst_customer'`.

The free-text rewrite matches a string value equal to an object name, and its regex has a right identifier boundary but no left one. The stored body and the registry agree.

The data plane addresses the column by the key:
- `engine.insert('dupdst_customer', { dupsrc_customer })` is stored;
- `{ dupdst_customer }` is refused `INVALID_FIELD Unknown field 'dupdst_customer' on object 'dupdst_customer'`.

The save door's `security-fls-unknown-field` lint reads the `name`. So once PR #23536 lands, a copied permission set with a rule on such a field is refused at the copy (`failed author-time validation … [security-fls-unknown-field]`), where before it copied fail-open.

**Done:** a copied field's key and `name` agree, through either the same rename or none. Pin it on a real kernel, with a negative control: a field whose name merely contains the source prefix in the middle keeps both.

## 2. A bare object's view item keeps its `OBJECT.VIEWKEY` name (class b)

`Seam: spec:ViewItemNameSchema (OBJECT.VIEWKEY) → runtime:ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.duplicatePackage (renameName on a non-object row name) | consumer: a by-name view read naming no package`

**The contract** (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`): "Qualified view-item identity: `<object>.<viewKey>` … the object can be recovered from the prefix, so the registry key never collides across objects."

**Measured.**
- The source view items `ticket.board` (object `ticket`, a bare object name) and `dupsrc_customer.board` are stored.
- The copy rows are `com.qa.dupdst:ticket.board` with `object: dupdst_ticket`, and `com.qa.dupdst:dupdst_customer.board` with `object: dupdst_customer`. The prefixed case is consistent; the bare case keeps the source object's prefix while its body names the copy.
- `protocol.getMetaItem({ type: 'view', name: 'ticket.board' })`, naming no package, serves the SOURCE row (`object: ticket`), so the copy is shadowed.

**Done:** the copy of a bare object's view item takes the renamed object's prefix (`dupdst_ticket.board`). Pin it on a real kernel, with a negative control: a view item of an object outside the package keeps its name.

**Noted, not measured (read from the code):** a view-item id inside a value (for example a form-view target) keeps a bare object's name in the copy.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `duplicatePackage field name half-renamed key name mismatch free-text regex left boundary view item name OBJECT.VIEWKEY bare object not renamed` → 7 hits:
- #23527 (open): permission `fields` keys.
- #21334, #22057, #22024 (closed): view container and served-view reads, not the duplicate.
- #19577 (closed): `targetNamespace` validation.
- #15495, #14166 (closed): unrelated.

None of them is either item here.

Dedupe words: duplicatePackage field key name mismatch; free-text regex no left boundary; duplicate view item name bare object not renamed; copied view item shadowed by source.
